name: Verner's Note
summary: In Redridge, Verner Osgood sends a written requisition west to Smith Argus in Goldshire. It describes Lakeshire’s iron shortage and asks the Elwynn smith for horseshoes.

sections.title: A Plea for Iron
sections.body: Lakeshire’s defense has consumed nearly all of Verner Osgood’s iron. The town’s blacksmith has used his reserves to arm and armor the Stormwind Guard, who are stretched thin against invading gnolls and local perils. Meanwhile, Lakeshire’s stables have fallen into neglect, without even basic horseshoes for their mounts. Verner asks Smith Argus in Goldshire to send prepared shoes from Elwynn, so the town can shoe its horses.

faq.q: What is written in Verner's Note?
faq.answer: Verner’s Note tells Smith Argus that Verner has spent nearly all his iron reserves arming and armoring the Stormwind Guard in Lakeshire. With no iron left for horseshoes, he asks Argus to send them from Goldshire.
Verner Osgood is the blacksmith operating out of Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. He outfits the town’s defenders and keeps working gear and beasts shod.

aliases: where do i bring the note
faq.answer: The note is carried westward down the road to Smith Argus, the blacksmith outside the forge in Goldshire, Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why can't Verner make the horseshoes himself?
aliases: why send to goldshire for shoes
faq.answer: Verner has used his iron reserves to forge weapons and make repairs for the Stormwind Guard, who face gnolls and other local perils. That leaves no iron for horseshoes.

angles.text: As a blacksmith, you can see how frontier warfare consumes supplies. When weapons and armor use every ingot, Lakeshire must import farrier supplies from safer settlements like Goldshire.
As an Alliance member, you can see the strain on Stormwind’s rural settlements. Lakeshire must coordinate with villages in the heartland to maintain its supply lines.
